title: Kefbab: Kebab, Tzatziki & Sweet Potato Wedges
one_liner: A grilled ground beef kebab recipe served with homemade tzatziki and spiced sweet potato wedges.
key_points: Flatten spiced ground beef on a tray, pre-cut, then grill at max heat close to the element for juicy inside and crispy outside
Tzatziki combines Greek yogurt, cucumber, dill, parsley, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, and a touch of honey
Sweet potato wedges are seasoned with paprika, cumin, coriander, chili flakes, and honey, then baked at 250°C for 20–30 min

instructions: 1. Mix ground beef with paprika, chili, cumin, coriander, garlic, onion, parsley, salt, and pepper.
2. Press mixture flat on a tray and pre-cut into portions.
3. Grill on max heat, placing tray very close to the grill until crispy outside and juicy inside.
4. Mix Greek yogurt, cucumber, dill, parsley, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, and a little honey for tzatziki.
5. Cut sweet potatoes into wedges, toss with olive oil, paprika, cumin, coriander, chili flakes, salt, pepper, and honey.
6. Bake sweet potato wedges at 250°C for 20–30 minutes.
